;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian civil war]]:
**The death toll of children in the entire conflict reaches nearly 15,000. [http://www.turkishpress.com/news/402475/ (Turkish Press)]
*Dozens of civilians sheltering in a [[United Nations|UN]] base in the [[South Sudan]] town of [[Bor, South Sudan|Bor]] are killed in an attack by armed men. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-27074635 (BBC News)]
*[[2014 pro-Russian unrest in Ukraine]]:
**Pro-[[Russia|Russian]] separatists in [[Donetsk]] say they will not leave the government buildings, defying the [[Kyiv]] authorities and threatening a new international deal on Ukraine. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-27076226 (BBC News)]
*[[Post-coup unrest in Egypt (2013–14)]]:
**A police officer is killed and another is wounded after a bomb detonates in a busy square in [[Greater Cairo|Cairo]]'s [[Mohandessin]] district. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2014/apr/18/cairo-bomb-explosion-kills-one-police-officer (''The Guardian'')]

;Business and economy
*Arts and crafts retailer [[Michaels]] announces that 3 million customers were affected by the 8-month long security breach that resulted in the theft of their customers' personal information. [http://money.cnn.com/2014/04/17/news/companies/michaels-security-breach/index.html?hpt=hp_t2 (CNN)]

*[[2014 South Korean ferry capsizing]]:

**[[South Korea|South Korean]] prosecutors have issued an arrest warrant for the captain, Lee Joon-seok, and are seeking the arrest of two other crew members of the ''[[2014 South Korean ferry capsizing|Sewol]]'' in the wake of the [[2014 South Korean ferry capsizing|ferry capsizing]].
